steps.label: :unreal: Direct portable contracts
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
source scripts/bazel/ci-cache.sh
export NUXIE_BAZEL_JOBS=2
python3 scripts/bazel/sdk.py test

steps.label: :apple: Direct Unreal native bridges
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
source scripts/bazel/ci-cache.sh
export NUXIE_BAZEL_JOBS=2
export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home}"
export ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/share/android-commandlinetools}"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
"$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" \
  "platforms;android-36" "build-tools;36.0.0" "ndk;29.0.14206865" \
  "cmake;3.22.1"
python3 scripts/bazel/sdk.py test-android
python3 scripts/prepare-android.py
python3 scripts/bazel/ios_simulator.py --minimum-os 17.0 -- python3 scripts/bazel/sdk.py test-ios
bash ThirdParty/IOS/scripts/build-framework.sh
